config.identity: 基于 AH53 名义版图的合成工艺形貌；非实测重建

scenes.status: 验证假设；现有 AH53_DEMO GDS 仅 8×2 μm，不能据其确定完整 Mark 尺寸

synthetic.field_definition: Independent random-phase finite Fourier sums; weights normalized so theoretical infinite-domain RMS equals configured RMS. Fixed spectral wavelengths >=160nm; short and long bands around 0.3um and2um. Finite-window actual RMS remeasured.

config.end_faces: Z ends close the computational window and are excluded from free-surface errors

settings.reference_definition: Independent analytic piecewise contour; no spline/triangle/voxel dependency
settings.sampling: Common piecewise ordered contour samples; nominal per-region arc-length upper envelopes; no fitted model used
settings.parameterization: six ordered contour parts C(u,Z); effective height is max Y; left/right interval queries invert the unimodal saved contour
settings.parameterization_reason: The crown has finite tangent in contour coordinates but unbounded |dX/dY| at its summit. Uniform-Y cubic interpolation amplifies endpoint coordinate error. Piecewise contour coordinates retain common arc-length observation spacing and bounded tangents; left/right representation remains mathematically valid.
